compatibilityNotes: Emulators and real hardware require a legally obtained ROM matching the target machine. This verified-good dump is suitable for archival emulation.
contentsDescription: Standard Amiga Kickstart firmware containing Exec, drivers, and Intuition.
history: Kickstart evolved from floppy-loaded prototypes to mask ROMs across the Amiga's commercial lifetime.
purpose: Stored in ROM (or loaded from disk on early A1000 setups), Kickstart initializes custom chips, brings up Chip RAM, installs core libraries, and hands control to boot media or the Workbench desktop.
summary: Kickstart is the Amiga's resident operating system firmware. This verified good image targets Amiga hardware and provides the Exec kernel, device drivers, Intuition GUI, and DOS library needed to boot Workbench or games.
technicalInsights: Match ROM revision to target hardware for accurate emulation.
title: Kickstart v1.4 alpha 18 r36.002
